requirement: Joomla planner: one unreadable batch keeps its words and the rest are written; icon markup never reaches the model

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026 local stand: Apply on Design inspiration ja-vega (Joomla) failed in 1 of 2 runs, 'Content mapping refused 3 times: ... not valid JSON', nothing written. Replaying that contract's plan with the real model: the same 33-slot batch was cut off 3/3 times in the middle of SVG path data (11 text slots hold ((svg ...)) icons up to 3.2 kB). After the fix: 3/3 Apply runs applied (397, 349 slots).
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 18). Both named cases are 'ok': a batch whose answer is cut off keeps its slots pending as 'model-unreadable' while the other batch is written; nothing readable at all still rejects with 'Content mapping refused 3 times'; a thrown model call still reaches the caller; an icon sample is neither asked about nor pending. S3 prints '11 11': every SVG icon text slot of ja-vega/j6/1.0.3 is recognised as markup with no words.
